USR-0001 Reduced need for in-clinic titration visits

TitleReduced need for in-clinic titration visits
Statusapproved
Order1
Implemented byREQ-0001

Statement

The patient needs sustained reduction in chronic neuropathic pain without requiring frequent in-clinic visits to manually re-titrate stimulation settings as their pain pattern or posture changes throughout the day.
